behavior: Use a fresh authenticated loopback model process per song and retire its owned Windows family after saving audio. Preserve legacy results and failed diagnostics. Prevent source updates during a private song worker.

focused_tests.scope: Music backend, radio sequencing, updater and music-related task integration; not a full-app suite

safety_and_lifecycle: One inference submission per case; no ambiguous POST replay
Exact owned process identity, random per-session API authentication and listener ownership
Parent-death and interruption cleanup exercised with actual Windows child processes
Temporary cache cleanup exercises actual successful real-song paths and preserves target hashes
Shared music API, its existing jobs and user files were not terminated or deleted
limits: Provided lyrics and installed checkpoints; times exclude lyric drafting and first-time downloads
Three songs on one PC, not long-term or all-hardware endurance validation
Whole-track offline speech recognition supports vocal presence and lyric matches, not subjective musical quality
System commit includes other applications and temporary diagnostic reader processes
An already-running legacy shared API may retain earlier memory until it exits normally
Model loading repeats per song; measured 38.65 to 52.88 seconds on this host
